correctness.rationale: Let C0 be largest Nash coalition: a missing type i agent would strictly improve by joining it, so C0 contains all types. Bilateral deviations for an i-agent between any coalition C and C0 imply M-m_i=u-c_i; summing over represented types produces (1-p)(M-u)=H where H is the positive mass of omitted types. Hence every coalition contains every type, M=u and each type count is equal, so r divides gcd(n_i). Balanced partitions have no improving unilateral move, and multiplying multinomials/dividing by r! counts them. Summing weak-blocker friend inequalities shows size U>=s and the U=s case all indifferent; all-strict blockers require U>=s+2. Enemies preclude weak blocker size s+1, while neutrals permit a one-agent augmentation; adding two different types gives core blockers at s+2. Grand coalition has no blocking proper subset. Independent 2808 full Nash-partition/preference tests corroborate.
